report: Launch Readiness Report — The Mini Mainframe
method: Parallel multi-dimension audit (perf, security, seo, ux-desktop, ux-mobile, a11y, bugs-code, build-health, automations, growth, signup-funnel, privacy/ops) with independent adversarial verification of every non-trivial finding, driven against a production build of main and against live prod www.mini-mainframe.com.
verdict_summary: Five app-breaking problems (2 blockers, 3 highs) survived verification, plus operational gates (no error monitoring, no support contact, uncapped 'capped' beta, unverified FK cascade). All fixes are S/M effort. Flips to YES once the blocker set is fixed, the operational gates closed, the gallery seeded, and everything re-verified live.

launch_blockers.title: Prod origin resolves to a dead Vercel deployment (miniaturemanager.vercel.app -> 404 DEPLOYMENT_NOT_FOUND)
launch_blockers.dimension: seo-technical / security / build-health (one root cause, dedup of 3 findings)
launch_blockers.location: src/proxy.ts:73 (redirect from req.nextUrl.origin); email builders src/lib/auth/passwordReset.ts:29, recoveryEmail.ts:27, signUp.ts:164; Vercel prod AUTH_URL / production domain alias
launch_blockers.evidence: Live curl: signed-out GET /dashboard,/collection,/recipes,/admin/gallery and unknown URLs all 307 to https://miniaturemanager.vercel.app/sign-in?from=... which returns 404 DEPLOYMENT_NOT_FOUND. /sign-in on www is 200 (only redirect host is wrong). Every gated response sets __Secure-authjs.callback-url=https%3A%2F%2Fminiaturemanager.vercel.app (host-scoped -> split-brain cookies). Email links use NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL ?? AUTH_URL ?? localhost; NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL undocumented/unset, AUTH_URL = dead host; https://miniaturemanager.vercel.app/sign-in/reset and /verify-email both 404. issueSignupEmailToken fires on every signup (signUp.ts:148).
launch_blockers.impact: Any signed-out user hitting a bookmark/deep-link/expired session, plus Googlebot/crawlers, dead-ends on a foreign 404. Sign-in on the preview host sets a session that never carries to www (branded domain looks signed-out). Every password-reset and email-verification link is a dead 404.
launch_blockers.fix: Vercel Production: AUTH_URL=https://www.mini-mainframe.com, NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL=https://www.mini-mainframe.com, AUTH_TRUST_HOST=true; reassign the production domain alias off the dead deployment; add NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL to .env.production.example + DEPLOY.md; redeploy from a FRESH git push (Redeploy reuses stale env snapshot). Re-verify: signed-out /dashboard 307 to www/sign-in; send one real reset email and click it.

launch_blockers.title: Gallery moderation is bypassable -> arbitrary/attacker-swapped images on the public all-ages gallery (+ blind SSRF)
launch_blockers.location: src/lib/actions/gallerySubmissions.ts:94-179; src/lib/ai/imageModeration.ts:137-152 (fetchImage); render sinks GalleryBrowser.tsx:166, AdminGalleryReview.tsx:71, r/[slug]/opengraph-image.tsx:42
launch_blockers.evidence: submitSchema validates imageUrl only as z.string().url().max(2048) -- no blob-host allowlist, no binding to the caller's uploaded blob. Action moderates the URL, auto-publishes on a Claude 'pass' (galleryStatus=approved, isListed=true, mints slug), stores it verbatim, gallery renders raw. Any signed-in free user can point imageUrl at their own host, serve clean during the moderation fetch, then swap to arbitrary content for all visitors (TOCTOU). fetchImage is a bare fetch(url) with no host allowlist (blind SSRF -- returns only verdict, no body). Second untrusted server-side fetch at r/[slug]/opengraph-image.tsx:40-42 reflects fetched bytes into the public OG image.
launch_blockers.impact: The headline moderation gate the feature is marketed on is bypassable; arbitrary/explicit content on an all-ages public page on day 1 = trust-and-safety/brand incident.
launch_blockers.fix: In submitRecipeToGallery reject any imageUrl whose host != *.public.blob.vercel-storage.com (reuse isProxiableBlobUrl), ideally verify pathname matches a gallery-cards blob this user owns; apply same allowlist inside fetchImage; render cardImageUrl through /api/blob-proxy or next/image locked remotePattern at ALL THREE sinks.

launch_blockers.title: og:image and twitter:image are unreachable for crawlers -> every homepage social unfurl shows no preview image
launch_blockers.evidence: Landing HTML advertises og:image=/opengraph-image-<hash> (extensionless). Matcher only excludes dot-extensions, so auth() gates it -> 307 to dead host -> 404 (reproduced with Twitterbot UA). Homepage links to Reddit/Discord/X/FB/iMessage unfurl with title+text but no hero image. /r/ card images work (r/ is matcher-excluded). Platforms cache OG for days-weeks.
launch_blockers.impact: Primary growth channel (posting into communities) posts image-less cards -- the strongest first-impression signal in a feed is gone.
launch_blockers.fix: Add opengraph-image|twitter-image to the proxy.ts:106 negative-lookahead. Self-sufficient one-liner (does NOT depend on B1). Verify curl -> 200 image/png; run X/FB/LinkedIn card debuggers.

launch_blockers.title: Password reset is a permanent-lockout dead end for every credentials signup (reads recoveryEmail, a column signup never fills)
launch_blockers.evidence: Signup writes users.email and stamps users.emailVerified. requestPasswordReset only issues a link when users.recoveryEmail AND recoveryEmailVerified are set -- different columns signup never populates (only set via the optional two-step Account-settings opt-in). Reproduced: signed up a real account -> recovery-email field empty -> /reset shows 'if that account has a verified recovery email, a reset link is on its way' and sends nothing. Even clicking the signup verify email only stamps emailVerified, not recoveryEmailVerified.
launch_blockers.impact: A user who forgets their only credential is permanently locked out with data stranded; the UI reassures them a link is coming. Affects everyone lacking a manually-configured verified recovery email (i.e. effectively all credentials users).
launch_blockers.fix: Issue the reset against the mandatory, format-validated users.email DIRECTLY (not gated on emailVerified, or the majority who never clicked the verify link stay locked out), or copy email->recoveryEmail when the signup verification link is consumed. Ships with B1 so the link resolves.

launch_blockers.title: No error monitoring or alerting exists anywhere -> launch blind
launch_blockers.evidence: Glob src/instrumentation*.ts -> none. Grep sentry|datadog|captureException|onRequestError|@vercel/otel -> zero source matches. Only runtime error surface is 17 console.error to ephemeral Vercel logs, no alert rule. DEPLOY.md has no monitor/alert/health/incident section.
launch_blockers.impact: B1 and B2 are only observable in prod; a day-1 regression of that class surfaces only via user complaints, and there is no support inbox (O2). Meta-gate that catches everything else.
launch_blockers.fix: Add instrumentation.ts with Sentry (or @vercel/otel + Vercel Log Drains) and one alert on error-rate + on /api/billing/webhook and submitRecipeToGallery.

launch_blockers.title: No reachable support / data-rights contact; locked-out users are stranded
launch_blockers.evidence: Policy points to 'the email listed on the site'; grep mailto:|support@|contact@|@mini-mainframe|@hrumf across src/ -> no matches. Only inbound channel is the in-app feedback form (requires sign-in; anonymous dropped unless NOTION_TOKEN set) inside the app shell -- unreachable to B4 lockout victims. GDPR requires a reachable controller contact.
launch_blockers.fix: Publish a real support/privacy email in footer + legal pages; accept anonymous feedback; add a contact link on /sign-in and the reset page.

launch_blockers.title: The 'free capped beta' ships with caps disabled and no rate limits/quota/captcha -> resource-uncapped
launch_blockers.dimension: ops / security (completeness pass NEW-7/8, merges rate-limit findings)
launch_blockers.evidence: BILLING_ENFORCED=false makes isWithinLimit unconditionally true. Grep rateLimit|throttle|429|turnstile|captcha -> only comments. Live: authed POST /api/recipe/ai {} cleared auth + inert Pro gate, no throttle; 5 rapid calls all processed. Signup has no captcha and no rate limit; bcrypt cost 10 doesn't slow account-creation rate.
launch_blockers.impact: No cap on the things that cost money/invite abuse: Anthropic calls (open to every signed-in user in a loop against the key), Groq calls (import fallback), Vercel Blob, scripted account creation.
launch_blockers.fix: Per-user daily quota on /api/recipe/ai + gallery-submit (DB counter), IP rate limit on credentials signup, Cloudflare Turnstile on /sign-up -- all independent of BILLING_ENFORCED.

launch_blockers.title: Prod account-deletion FK cascade is unverified on remote Turso (may orphan all user data while reporting success)
launch_blockers.location: src/db/client.ts (no PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON); account.ts:deleteAccount (relies on ON DELETE CASCADE)
launch_blockers.evidence: Empirical libSQL probe: local file: connection cascades correctly. Prod uses remote Turso over libsql:// (different enforcement path, known SQLite/libSQL divergence). If OFF, db.delete(users) deletes one row, returns {ok:true}, orphans every project/recipe/collection row. recipeStepCompletion cascades transitively.
launch_blockers.fix: Add PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON on connection init (harmless if on), OR run one prod smoke: create throwaway account with a project, delete, confirm zero orphaned projects for that ownerId.

findings.title: Collection URL auto-fill silently fails for Games Workshop (#1 advertised brand) + fires a false green 'Added' toast
findings.evidence: GW paint URL creates a row titled literally 'games-workshop.com' with brand/type/price '--'; insert succeeds so a green success toast fires. GW 301s to warhammer.com which returns 405 to the scraper UA (Cloudflare); safeFetchHtml returns null before any parser. Adding warhammer.com to gw.ts hostnames does NOT help (fetch fails first).
findings.fix: Honest 'couldn't auto-read -- enter details below' state instead of hostname-title + green toast; drop GW from the advertised auto-fill list or route via headless/API.

findings.title: Status/Type/Priority dropdowns have no optimistic UI -- control greys out showing the OLD value for the whole round-trip
findings.evidence: grep useOptimistic -> 0. Measured local warm zero-latency SQLite median 46ms (label paints only at round-trip completion); +100ms RTT->572ms, +200ms->1057ms (serial 2-hop waterfall). Prod floor /gallery warm 155-195ms; /dashboard strictly worse (auth()+~16-stmt loadAppData). Realistic ~0.6-1.1s warm.
findings.fix: useOptimistic on the project view-model, apply picked value synchronously before awaiting, drop disabled={pending} from the Listboxes. Masking not speedup; P2 reduces the work.

findings.title: Intermittent permanent hang: after a field change the three controls stay disabled showing the stale value until reload
findings.evidence: ~3-5% of changes (race). When the router.refresh() ?_rsc= fetch is one of the aborted requests from the storm, isPending never clears and disabled={pending} bricks all three shared controls. Data safe (F5 shows the write landed).
findings.fix: Subsumed by P1+P2: drop disabled={pending}+paint optimistically; remove router.refresh().

findings.title: Every mutation fires an 18-request router.refresh() RSC storm (~19x loadAppData/invocations)
findings.evidence: 1 POST + 18 ?_rsc= across all 9 sidebar routes (default-prefetch) + 6-10 aborted, ~1540ms busy. Page rendered twice. CORRECTED: visible edit updates on the POST (~400ms); storm is background prefetch, not a user stall. Harm = server-side amplification.
findings.fix: Delete router.refresh() (force-dynamic pages already re-render on POST). MUST pair with P3 revalidatePath fix.

findings.title: Library virtualization defeated on mobile -- 7,152 DOM nodes / 28,333px page vs 849 nodes on desktop
findings.location: AppShell.tsx:31 (content column lacks min-h-0 in flex-col shell at :23)
findings.evidence: Measured 390px: 7152 <button>, scrollHeight 28333px, zero bounded scroll container. 1440px: 849 nodes, bounded 900px scroller (react-virtual works). ERR_INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES came from repeated headless nav, not one load -> elevated risk not guaranteed crash.
findings.fix: Add min-h-0 to the content column at AppShell.tsx:31; re-measure mobile button count (target few dozen).

findings.title: saveRecipe deletes all slots before re-inserting with no transaction -- partial failure truncates the recipe
findings.evidence: On edit, deletes all recipe_slots then re-inserts in a loop; any addSlot {ok:false} mid-loop (bad hex, or transient remote-Turso insert error) leaves the recipe truncated with no rollback/snapshot. cloneRecipe rolls back manually; saveRecipe does not.
findings.fix: Snapshot slots and restore on any failure, or persist the new set before deleting the old; validate up front.

findings.title: Double-click '+ New Project' creates duplicate projects (pending flag discarded, button never disabled)
findings.evidence: const [, creatingProject] = useTransition() discards isPending; create buttons have no disabled prop. Reproduced 1->3 rows from one native double-click on the empty-state CTA. createProject has no dedupe.
findings.fix: Capture creating, thread disabled to all create buttons + early-return guard (native dbl-click ~15ms apart).

findings.title: Email-verification link dead-ends at /sign-in for signed-out visitors
findings.evidence: Both omitted from isPublicPath and matcher; reproduced 307 -> /sign-in?from=... The page validates the token server-side and needs no session. Distinct from B1 (which makes the host dead).
findings.fix: Add /verify-email and /user/verify-recovery to isPublicPath + matcher exclusions.

findings.title: Password change/reset does not revoke the user's other active sessions
findings.evidence: Both update passwordHash but never delete other session rows; only destroyCurrentSession deletes (the current token). DB sessions live 30 days. Stolen cookie survives a reset up to 30 days.
findings.fix: On reset delete all sessions for userId then re-mint; on change-password delete all except the current token (SESSION_COOKIE).

findings.title: Signed-out color-tool pages are a navigation + work-loss dead-end (the SEO landing pages)
findings.evidence: 200 signed-out, no chrome, only '<- TOOLS' (307s to /sign-in). Save/Send-to-Recipe silently redirect mid-transition, discarding the generated palette + typed name. Save is ALSO Pro-gated in code (inert while BILLING_ENFORCED=false).
findings.fix: Public header + Sign-up CTA + inline 'sign in to save' preserving state (MockProvider exposes signedIn). Note free vs Pro save gate is a separate decision.

findings.title: Full-page project view (/projects/[id]) cannot edit granular model progress; add buttons bounce to the dashboard
findings.location: ProjectPageClient.tsx:384,432 (route to /dashboard?open=); ModelCounterGrid only in ProjectWorkspaceBody
findings.evidence: ModelCounterGrid (Built/Primed/Painted/Completed steppers) renders only in the inspector. Full page has full inline EditableDetails (status/type/priority/notes/date) so NOT read-only -- the defect is the missing stepper + silent bounce (cross-view inconsistency).
findings.fix: Render ModelCounterGrid on the full page for leaf nodes, or make add buttons open an inline dialog.

findings.title: loadAppData runs the full ~16-statement batch on every (app) route; recipe read 3x, recipe_slot 2x; unbounded queries
findings.evidence: /library,/tools,/user render none of it but pay it. recipe read 3x (listRecipesForTable, getProjectPalettesMap, getInspoMapForOwner), recipe_slot 2x. listAllProjects/listPaintCollection/listModelCollection unbounded. CORRECTION: do NOT strip /collection (reads data.collectionPaints etc -> would fall back to demo fixtures); App Router doesn't re-run layout on soft sibling nav.
findings.fix: Slice per-route (only /library/tools/user safe to strip), de-dup the triple recipe read (P5), add pagination.

findings.title: Production cold start ~1.4-2.2s on a dynamic route
findings.evidence: curl /gallery cold TTFB 2213ms then 195/157ms warm (re-measured 1.43s another day). Static / ~100ms HIT. /dashboard cold path heavier. CORRECTION: router.refresh() reduction is a warm-latency win, not a cold-start cure; usually absorbed by the session's first navigation.
findings.fix: Vercel Fluid Compute / warming cron on (app); confirm Turso primary == pdx1.

findings.title: /recipes issues ~3N redundant DB round-trips (N+1) re-fetching data loadAppData already loaded
findings.evidence: Awaits loadAppData (bulk-loads all slots+inspo), discards it, then Promise.all(summaries.map(loadEditorRecipe)) = 3 queries/recipe + dup loadProjectsForPicker. CORRECTIONS: 3N run concurrently (connection pressure, not serial RTT); client receives each recipe ONCE not twice.
findings.fix: Extend listRecipesForTable to carry technique+paintId+notesMd; drop the per-recipe loop + duplicate projects call.

findings.title: html-to-image ships eagerly to /recipes (and app-wide zero code-splitting) for a rarely-opened share modal
findings.evidence: grep next/dynamic -> 0. html-to-image (~42KB gz) sits in the /recipes static graph, downloaded/parsed before any modal opens; emitted as a duplicate chunk. Route-JS numbers are uncompressed; real win is parse/execute on mobile CPUs.
findings.fix: next/dynamic({ssr:false}) on ShareCardComposer/AiRecipeDialog/ArmyImportPanel/color-picker panels; investigate duplicate chunk.

findings.title: All key routes force-dynamic vs remote Turso; Turso primary region unasserted anywhere in the repo
findings.evidence: No region/replica/sync assertion in repo. CORRECTION: 12 loaders run in Promise.all (~2-3 hop depth, not 16x serial). Prod gallery warm ~160ms (~45ms over static baseline). Single-query route under-represents authed dashboard.
findings.fix: Confirm Turso primary == pdx1; adopt embedded replicas (libSQL sync) so reads are function-local.

findings.title: No HTTP security headers on prod (no CSP, X-Frame-Options/frame-ancestors, nosniff, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy)
findings.evidence: curl prod returns only HSTS (max-age=63072000, no includeSubDomains/preload). CORRECTION: destructive mutations are server actions with same-origin Origin/Host check -> cross-origin frames can't silently invoke; realistic clickjacking is UI-redress only.
findings.fix: headers() block: CSP report-only first (app uses inline styles), X-Frame-Options DENY + frame-ancestors none, nosniff, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy; add includeSubDomains to HSTS.

findings.title: Wildcard next/image remotePatterns turns prod into an open image-optimization proxy (cost abuse; blind SSRF)
findings.evidence: Live GET /_next/image?url=https://picsum.photos/64 -> 200 image/jpeg (arbitrary host). Anyone can burn Vercel's metered optimizer/egress and serve arbitrary images from the branded origin. SSRF is blind (optimizer returns only decodable images).
findings.fix: Restrict to *.public.blob.vercel-storage.com + curated hosts, drop http wildcard; route user-pasted reference URLs through a same-origin proxy (else the paste-reference feature breaks).

findings.title: Admin gate keys on an unverified, user-settable email with a hard-coded fallback
findings.evidence: isAdminEmail is the only gate, never checks emailVerified; signup stores arbitrary email with no verification. If MM_ADMIN_EMAILS unset in prod AND the fallback email isn't registered, an attacker self-signs-up into gallery-moderation admin. Doubly conditional; blast radius = gallery moderation.
findings.fix: Confirm MM_ADMIN_EMAILS set (zero-code mitigation); fail closed when unset; require emailVerified or key off stable user id / DB role.

findings.title: Stripe webhook has no idempotency and never writes the Founder seat counter
findings.evidence: No event.id dedupe; replayed checkout re-stamps founderClaimedAt and resets planExpiresAt. metaCounters.founder_sold never incremented anywhere -> '100 of 100 remaining' never decrements, seat #101 sellable. schema.ts:1375 falsely documents an atomic bump. Signature verify + core plan-grant are correct.
findings.fix: Persist processed event.id (unique constraint, no-op replays); pre-check founder_sold at checkout-session creation and increment (refusing in the webhook is too late).

findings.title: No executed test covers the live Stripe checkout route or webhook
findings.evidence: Only checkout e2e is skipped; billing-limit integration tests are the 5 observed skips. /api/billing/checkout and webhook plan-grant handler have no executed test. Stripe is live in prod.
findings.fix: Integration test for the webhook (signed event -> plan written) + checkout-route unit test per priceKey; run regardless of BILLING_ENFORCED.

findings.title: Browser-extension API is unreachable: proxy 307s every /api/extension/* to /sign-in before Bearer auth runs
findings.location: src/proxy.ts:104-108 (matcher omits api/extension); api/extension/add + preview routes
findings.evidence: Bearer-only request (no cookie) -> req.auth?.user null -> 307 to /sign-in (reproduced). Add/preview never worked end-to-end. Zero impact today (not on Web Store); will break when extension ships. Token crypto (HMAC/timingSafeEqual/version-bump) is sound.
findings.fix: Add api/extension to matcher exclusions + e2e test with only a Bearer header.

findings.title: Every text input renders at 13px, triggering iOS Safari auto-zoom on focus (incl. the sign-in form)
findings.location: globals.css:156 (--text-body:0.8125rem) via Input.tsx:49; viewport layout.tsx:46 doesn't lock maximum-scale
findings.evidence: Measured 390px iPhone: sign-in username/password 13px; all form fields 12-13px. iOS zooms when focused input <16px. Recoverable (maximum-scale not locked).
findings.fix: Form controls >=16px on mobile (scope to input/select/textarea; text-base=14px is NOT enough; do NOT lock maximum-scale -- WCAG 1.4.4).

findings.title: Many interactive controls are 24-33px tall -- below the 44px HIG guideline, several under/at the WCAG 2.5.8 24px floor
findings.location: segmented toggles, filter pills, gallery Clone, tools harmony/picker buttons, 17px collection retailer links
findings.evidence: Measured 390px: Grid/List 60x26, Clone 181x32, harmony 300x30, colour pickers 24x24, retailer links 17px tall, layer-name input 22px. 44px is HIG (not WCAG); genuine WCAG 2.5.8 concern = the 17px links + 22px input.
findings.fix: Raise to 44px, or 24px + adequate spacing; give inline retailer links vertical padding or convert to chips.

findings.title: Hero 'Start for Free' CTA sits below the fold on a common 13" laptop; header has no signup affordance
findings.evidence: Measured CTA top=893px: below fold at 1366x768, clipped at 1440x900. Header exposes only 'Sign in' (wrong door for a new user). Mobile fine.
findings.fix: Cap hero illustration (~40vh) so CTA clears 768px; add persistent 'Start for Free' to PublicHeader.

findings.title: Value proposition isn't legible in 5 seconds -- niche and 'why not a spreadsheet' hook buried
findings.evidence: Visible fold = wordmark + illustration + 'Plan your projects / Track your paints / Manage your minis'; only niche signal is 'minis'. Real H1 is sr-only (fine for SEO). Niche IS reinforced below in body/showcase copy.
findings.fix: Add a visible benefit-led keyword sub-headline naming the audience/payoff; keep CRT branding. Post-launch A/B candidate.

findings.title: Form validation errors are not announced or programmatically linked to fields (sign-up/sign-in)
findings.evidence: aria-invalid set but error span has no id/role/aria-live and input has no aria-describedby; zero live regions. Screen reader hears 'invalid entry' with no reason on account creation. WCAG 3.3.1 A + 4.1.3 AA.
findings.fix: Stable error id + aria-describedby on input + aria-live=polite on span (one shared primitive fixes every form).

findings.title: 841 interactive paint swatches announce as 'list item' not 'button' (invalid role on the Library grid)
findings.evidence: axe aria-allowed-role on 841 nodes: <button role='listitem'>. ARIA role overrides native button semantics; keyboard still works. WCAG 4.1.2 A. selectMode branch uses role=checkbox which IS valid.
findings.fix: Drop role='listitem' (non-selectMode branch only); if a list is wanted wrap buttons in <li>.

findings.title: Footer links distinguishable by color alone (2.11:1) with underline only on hover
findings.evidence: text-cyan-lite hover:underline; computed #4aa8da vs #e6e5e5 = 2.11:1 (<3:1). Underline only on hover -> color-only for keyboard/no-hover. WCAG 1.4.1 A.
findings.fix: Persistent underline underline-offset-2 (cheapest; keeps the 2-tier accent contract). Sweep all text-cyan-lite hover:underline inline links.

findings.title: The homepage contains none of the target search phrases
findings.evidence: Live grep of visible HTML: wargame/warhammer/painting tracker/project tracker/paint collection/inventory/pile of shame/Citadel/Vallejo/Army Painter all 0. Only visible h1 is sr-only. CORRECTED high->medium (page is indexable/on-topic, not invisible).
findings.fix: Query-led title, keyword meta, VISIBLE keyword sub-headline under the logo, weave terms into FEATURES.

findings.title: Gallery + every /r/ recipe card are orphaned from the sitemap with thin metadata (dedup of 3 findings)
findings.evidence: Prod sitemap.xml has 0 /r/ or /gallery entries; /r/ pages render unique content but keyword-free title/description and twitter:title falls back to brand string; no canonical. CORRECTED high->medium (crawlable + internally linked, just slow/incomplete indexing).
findings.fix: Async sitemap: add /gallery + listPublishedRecipes()->/r/<slug> with lastModified=updatedAt; keyword title + per-recipe twitter object + canonical.

findings.title: Zero structured data (JSON-LD) anywhere
findings.evidence: grep application/ld+json -> 0 files; live HTML ld+json count 0 on home/pricing/gallery. Ineligible for rich results.
findings.fix: WebApplication + FAQPage on homepage (FAQ doubles as keyword copy), BreadcrumbList on gallery/r. NO aggregateRating (no real reviews). NOT Recipe/HowTo (food-semantic/retired).

findings.title: www vs apex split-brain: robots Host, sitemap locs, metadataBase, og:image all name apex while prod serves www; no canonical
findings.evidence: apex 308->www (www is only 200) but all internal signals name apex; every sitemap URL 308-redirects (GSC 'Page with redirect'); no rel=canonical anywhere. Not fatal (308 is a canonical signal). CORRECTED high->medium.
findings.fix: Set metadataBase/sitemap BASE/robots BASE to https://www.mini-mainframe.com (also fixes og:image host); add alternates.canonical per page.

findings.title: Only 6 thin indexable pages exist -- no keyword-targeted landing/content pages
findings.evidence: Indexable set = /, /pricing, /sign-in, /sign-up, /privacy, /terms. No feature/comparison/blog pages. Homepage asked to rank for everything.
findings.fix: Build ~6-7 hand-written 600-900 word keyword landing pages (static/ISR) + a lightweight blog. Growth roadmap, not a quick task.

findings.title: The 7,144-paint cross-brand catalog is a latent programmatic-SEO goldmine, fully gated + client-side (invisible to Google)
findings.evidence: 7k paints (hex/brand/type), no public per-paint URL. Own rows carry sourceUrl:minimatch.app/paint/... (a competitor already ranks off this data). 'X equivalent in Y' queries unserved.
findings.fix: Generate /paint/[brand]/[slug] (ΔE nearest-brand match table) + /paint-conversion/[a]-to-[b]; static/ISR; shard sitemap via generateSitemaps(); quality-gate on hexConfidence; add routes to isPublicPath/sitemap, keep out of robots Disallow.

findings.title: sign-in and sign-up are in the sitemap but are thin pages with identical generic titles + inherited description
findings.evidence: Both title 'The Mini Mainframe', same inherited description. Duplicate-title thin pages advertised for indexing. (They DO have a description, inherited from root layout.)
findings.fix: Drop from sitemap + robots:{index:false} (client pages need a server wrapper for the metadata export).

findings.title: The share card -- the artifact that travels to new rooms -- carries the brand name but no address/URL
findings.evidence: cardRef node's only brand element is the MINI-MAINFRAME wordmark; grep for mini-mainframe.com/https/qr -> nothing but a comment. /r/ OG image DOES print the domain. CORRECTED high->medium (wordmark is searchable, not a hard dead-end).
findings.fix: Footer strip INSIDE cardRef: 'mini-mainframe.com' (static covers both DOWNLOAD+SUBMIT via renderCardPng; DOWNLOAD can run recipeId==null), ideally /r/<slug> + inline QR.

findings.title: The viral loop (card download, gallery submit, clone) fires zero analytics -- launch semi-blind
findings.location: ShareCardComposer handleDownload/handleSubmit; gallerySubmissions.ts; recipeSharing.ts cloneRecipeFromSlug; events.ts
findings.evidence: No trackClient/trackServer on the loop. PublicRecipeShared fires only in publishRecipe (secondary public-link surface, NOT inert -- isProUser true in beta). CORRECTION: gallery submits + clones leave DB rows (gallerySubmittedAt, cloneCount) and Vercel Analytics auto-tracks pageviews; only card DOWNLOAD is truly invisible.
findings.fix: Add CardDownloaded (client, priority), CardSubmittedToGallery + RecipeCloned (server).

findings.title: No re-engagement loop -- the app has all the data to pull painters back weekly and never uses it
findings.location: vercel.json (no crons); Resend (verify/reset only); schema (event, paint_sessions, project counters)
findings.evidence: No cron, no digest/reminder outbound. CORRECTION: the in-app streak IS built (src/lib/streak.ts + StatRow); only the outbound email channel is missing.
findings.fix: Vercel cron -> weekly digest via existing Resend mailer (upcoming events within N days + backlog). Mind transactional-vs-marketing consent + Resend deliverability.

findings.title: Public color tools are usable signed-out but robots-disallowed AND sitemap-absent -- a high-intent funnel switched off
findings.evidence: Prod 200 signed-out for all four tool pages, but robots blocks them and sitemap omits them: reachable but undiscoverable. /tools hub itself 307s. CORRECTED high->medium (product not invisible; upside speculative). Depends on signed-out tool UX (T1 dead-end).
findings.fix: Decide posture: if public, fix signed-out UX first, then un-disallow + sitemap + public meta; else add /tools/* to isPublicPath to match the gated hub.

findings.title: The moat isn't visible: the launch gallery is abstract swatch strips, not painted models
findings.evidence: All 8 seed cards have cardImageUrl null -> swatch-strip fallback (verified live: zero model-photo imgs). Differentiator is painted model + recipe; cold visitor sees colour bars. Seed script has no cardImageUrl field (needs live submit flow, not just data edit).
findings.fix: Before launch, seed 8-15 real painted-model photo cards through the live ShareCardComposer + submit flow.

findings.title: Time-to-value: new signups land on an empty dashboard and are pushed to data-entry, not the one-click 'wow'
findings.evidence: ~6 interactions + manual data entry before value. 'Clone to my library' lands a populated recipe in one action and tools work signed-out, but neither appears in the hero (sign-up 3x, gallery 0x) or empty states.
findings.fix: Add 'Browse the gallery -- clone a starter recipe' to empty states; add 'See the gallery (no signup)' hero CTA; visible keyword H1; cap hero illustration.

findings.title: Free->paid: recipe sharing is partly Pro-gated (throttles the loop) and Founder scarcity is unbacked
findings.evidence: publishRecipe (mint /r/ link) is Pro-gated while submitRecipeToGallery (same capability) is free. Inert today (BILLING_ENFORCED=false). Founder '100 seats' counter never incremented (see webhook finding); pricing currently sells Founder as 'Planned -- free during testing' with no live counter.
findings.fix: Make ALL sharing free forever (pull the Pro gate from publishRecipe); wire the real seat counter or drop 'Limited launch'.

findings.title: npm run lint is broken and CI runs no linter at all
findings.evidence: 'next lint' removed in Next 16 -> parses 'lint' as a dir, lints zero files, exits 1. No ESLint flat config; eslint v9 installed unconfigured. ci.yml quality job runs typecheck/unit/integration/build, no lint step.
findings.fix: Migrate to ESLint 9 flat config (eslint.config.mjs extending eslint-config-next), change script to 'eslint .', add lint step to CI.

findings.title: Deploy runbook omits 5 env-var groups the live app depends on and still documents removed magic-link auth
findings.evidence: Docs cover 7 vars; code reads STRIPE_* (x5), BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL, MM_ADMIN_EMAILS undocumented. DEPLOY.md still says magic-link auth + references dead monorepo path. Also stale: dropped-table list, 'not in production yet' section (Stripe/tiers/images have shipped).
findings.fix: Add missing vars with sources, mark hard-required (Stripe/Blob/Anthropic); correct auth section to credentials-based; fix stale sections.

findings.title: 'Export all your data' is incomplete (6 of 16 tables) -> GDPR portability gap + false privacy-policy claim
findings.evidence: Exports projects/recipes/recipeSlots/palettes/inventoryEntries/wishlistItems; omits paintNotes, paintSessions, events, activityLog, projectImages, inspoImages, recipeInspo, imports, recipeStepCompletion, feedback. Policy says 'export all of your data' and names sessions+events (both omitted).
findings.fix: Add missing tables (and image URLs) to exportAllUserData, or soften policy copy to 'core content'.

findings.title: Account deletion never removes the user's Vercel Blob objects -> GDPR erasure (Art.17) gap
findings.evidence: deleteAccount does db.delete(users) only; project images, inspo images, gallery share-card PNGs live in Vercel Blob with no del()/cleanup. Deleted user's photos persist and raw blob URLs keep resolving.
findings.fix: Enumerate the user's blob URLs and call Vercel Blob del() (best-effort, non-blocking) before the row delete.

findings.title: Privacy policy omits the AI + analytics subprocessors that receive user data
findings.evidence: Lists only Vercel, 'our database provider', Stripe, 'an email provider'. Does not disclose Anthropic (recipe prompts + gallery-moderation images), Groq (army-list text via import fallback), Vercel Analytics. GDPR Art.13/28.
findings.fix: Add Anthropic, Groq, Vercel Analytics; note submitted images/prompts are processed by an AI provider.

findings.title: No rollback plan, no automated pre-deploy DB snapshot; prod migrations auto-apply on every deploy
findings.evidence: migrate-or-skip runs db:migrate against prod on every build (libSQL statements not wrapped in one transaction). DEPLOY.md documents only Turso 24h auto-backups; no rollback runbook, no pre-migration snapshot gate, no status page.
findings.fix: Manual .dump snapshot as an explicit gate for schema-changing releases; one-paragraph rollback runbook; keep migrations strictly additive.

findings.title: Army/roster import pipeline (BattleScribe/PDF/text/JSON + Groq LLM fallback) never exercised end-to-end
findings.evidence: Explicitly skipped by all auditors. Accepts a 20MB base64 upload, decodes, runs PDF text extraction, and on low parser confidence (<0.6) ships user paste to Groq (undisclosed subprocessor). Untested file-decode + untested external-LLM egress. Highest-risk untested surface.
findings.fix: At minimum a manual smoke of an army-list paste (both deterministic parser and Groq fallback) + one inspo-image upload before go-live.

verifier_refutations_and_corrections: Three findings (build-health canonical-URL, seo-technical AUTH-redirect, security AUTH-misconfig) were one root cause -> deduped to B1.
Two password-reset findings had contradictory gating and a partially-wrong fix -> merged to B4 with the robust fix (reset against users.email unconditionally).
'19x function invocations' per click -> corrected to 2 user-facing; the 18-request storm is background prefetch, harm reframed as server-side amplification.
GW scrape 'silent failure' -> fires a green success toast; the proposed gw.ts hostname fix is ineffective (405 before any parser runs).
Many SEO/growth 'high' findings downgraded to medium -- the product is not invisible to Google (indexable homepage/pricing/gallery exist).
Cold-start fix corrected: router.refresh() reduction is a warm-latency win, not a cold-start cure.
loadAppData relocation corrected: must not strip /collection (would show demo fixtures).
iOS-zoom and touch-target severities trimmed high->medium (recoverable friction / missed best-practice).
Wildcard-image 'SSRF' narrowed to blind (no body exfil); clickjacking narrowed (server-action same-origin check).
/recipes 'ships every recipe twice' -> false (client receives each once); 'serial 3N RTT' -> concurrent connection pressure.
Share-card 'every posted card is a leaked acquisition' softened -- the MINI-MAINFRAME wordmark is searchable.
